016d57ec.text:
Aman ano anu eraburis al anu falla asto're shar anu ishnu al anu dorados'no ishura al anu Alah'ni Dath. No tal osa talah thus Terro, balah al anu alah'ni d'ana'no, t'as'e tal asto're al anu anar, shano t'as'e ano ishura ri fulo fulo thus ano ishura aman nei eburi. Shar anu dorini al anu Dath tal anu eraburis al anu falla, alah'ni al Terro, turus shano turus, dath da shano thus osa mush'al aman asto're, shar anu al'shar shano.

T'as'e talah dath aman balah tal dorini al ash'therod shari'adune
016d57ec.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

0938d1f1.text:
Where once I thought it preposterous that a human would come to our lands and learn our ways, this wizard, this evil man, came here and not only survived, but also gained some of our knowledge. I'm still uncertain how...

I never discovered his goals during my investigation, but his plan seemed simple: using druidic magic, he wanted to befriend and then control the furbolg. If it was in an attempt to harm my kin, or for some other malicious purpose, I hope to find out before my path ends.
0938d1f1.title: Teronis' Journal

1a152bba.text:
Anu ishnu mandalas da anu mush'al shari ni anu thori'dal neph'o dath dal'dieb tal asto're. Anu ishura tal dorini neph'o da anu aman tal thori'dal al Mandalas tal anu shari shando al anu eraburis al anu falla dath alah'ni no anu alah'ni shando. Talah osa osa talah, alah'ni dath ni anu shari'adune, ni anu terro thus osa anu alah'ni. Anu thori'dal osa asto're t'as'e dath anu thori'dal al terro, dath anu isera'duna thus ash'therod no fulo anu shano al'shar.

Mush'al t'as'e mush'al. Shando t'as'e
1a152bba.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

2c3af560.text:
Regardless, he was apparently more successful than naught in actualizing his plans. Did he want to attempt his machinations on the furbolg before trying on my people? Did the furbolg have something he coveted? Who knows?

Using an item he created (a rod or staff of some kind), he attempted to infiltrate the furbolg tribes of Ashenvale. At some point, and this is where many of the details are still unclear, he was discovered by the furbolg while trying to manipulate them into acting against
2c3af560.title: Teronis' Journal

33f57b36.text:
I started this journal so I could keep notes on my quest to help Ashenvale. There is a mystery to some of the events that occurred not too long ago, and hopefully I will be able to unravel some of it in order to help my people.

Let me start by putting down facts so they don't slip my mind at a later date.

I've recently found truth to the rumors of the wizard Dartol's efforts.
33f57b36.title: Teronis' Journal

5a4d394b.text:
He tells me he's been throughout all of Dor'danil, and he's never seen a chest or any container that may hold the pommel. 

He also tells me that rotting slimes have inhabited the area, and they devour almost anything smaller than them. He's seen them "eat" tables, sculptures, bears, and even gnomes!

The slimes seem to gain a great deal of sustenance from things magical. If the chest holding the pommel was enchanted at all, the slimes might have eaten it.
5a4d394b.title: Teronis' Journal

8b00bc0d.text:
If I can't find the gem hidden in the shrine, it might be in the possession of one of the murlocs.

The shaft portion
This part of the rod was given to the treants near what is now called Felwood. Neither the furbolg nor my kind could have suspected that such magnificent creatures could ever fall to the corruption that's overtaken the land.

My research tells me that the guardians kept the piece in a small glade locked within a chest. To find out any more, I'll have to speak to Shael'dryn.
8b00bc0d.title: Teronis' Journal

9368d9b6.text:
Shael'dryn is a dryad who protects the moonwell northeast of Lake Iris. She refuses to leave the forest or forsake it to the corruption. I know she has the power and knowledge to repair the rod, or to at least tell me how I can do it on my own.

The pommel
The pommel of the rod was given to the druids of Dor'danil. There is one major problem with this though: the druids are dead.

Their spirits now inhabit the area and are no longer hospitable.
9368d9b6.title: Teronis' Journal

9990e024.text:
one another. As I'm sure the elves would be, the furbolg were angered, but they reacted much more strongly and killed Dartol.

The furbolg, at least at this time, weren't the same corrupted creatures they've become. They were still rational and intelligent--their relationship with our people amicable.

I'm hoping that if I can recreate the rod with the help of a dryad named Shael'dryn, I can use its power to help our people... and the furbolg.
9990e024.title: Teronis' Journal

9ae5e874.text:
It's a gamble, but I have no other clues at this time...

As I find out more I'll put the details here; but until then, I shall work on finding the parts of the rod and helping Ashenvale.
9ae5e874.title: Teronis' Journal

9c9ee49f.text:
This may require more investigation. I'm not sure I'm powerful enough to fight the spirits of my dead kin...let alone delve into the depths of Dor'danil and find the pommel.

(Note: During my preparations in Astranaar, I've recently met a dwarf hunter who has spent a good portion of his time in Ashenvale trying to help my people. He came from a place called Stormwind.

We spoke over a few ales one night, and his tales have given me new hope of finding the pommel...
9c9ee49f.title: Teronis' Journal

ae8a06fd.text:
Along with killing Dartol, the furbolg split up the rod into three parts so it couldn't be used against them again. It has been difficult, but I've a good idea where all three parts were placed.

The Gem
The first part of the rod, a glowing gem, was hidden in a shrine in Northwestern Ashenvale. I believe now this shrine is the ruins at the center of Lake Falathim. The Sentinels tell me that it's been inhabited by murlocs now.
ae8a06fd.title: Teronis' Journal

d353ee0a.text:
Not all the furbolg have been corrupted. Some still live and try to protect the forest. During their corruption, some of the furbolg fled, many were killed, and others were forced out of their tribes.

I found a venerable furbolg of the Foulweald tribe living above Lake Mystral--his name is Krolg.

I've watched him for days, and I think if I were to approach him in the guise of a furbolg, I could help him and discover a way to re-establish a bond between our people.
d353ee0a.title: Teronis' Journal

118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

1579-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-progress.text: Did you find my gaffer jacks, $N?  Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
1579-progress.title: Gaffer Jacks

1580-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-progress.text: Did you find any electropellers?  I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
1580-progress.title: Electropellers

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2078-progress.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2078-progress.text: Where be me first mate, $N? Shackles n' sharks fer ye soon if ye don't hurry!
2078-progress.title: Gyromast's Revenge

2098-progress.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-progress.text: Have ye found me broke down key, landlubber?
2098-progress.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2178-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-progress.text: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
2178-progress.title: Easy Strider Living

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4722-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4722-progress.text: Hello $N - do you have any discoveries of creatures that have washed ashore to report on?
4722-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4725-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4725-progress.text:
It is a pleasure to see you again, $N.  We are making great strives in uncovering the mystery of why majestic sea creatures beach themselves on the Darkshore coastline, but with every question answered, two more are raised it seems.

Are you here to offer us more aid in our research?
4725-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4728-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  What brings you back to Auberdine?  Are you here to report on another discovery, perhaps?
4728-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4730-progress.text: Hello again, $N!  Are you here to report on another discovery?
4730-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4731-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4731-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  The work you have done on behalf of the Temple of the Moon has been outstanding.  Are we to be blessed with more of your effort on our behalf?
4731-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4732-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4732-progress.text: Greetings once again $N - do you have any more discoveries to report to the Temple of the Moon?
4732-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4733-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4733-progress.text: Thanks be to Elune - I am glad to see you again, dear $N.  The Temple of the Moon's work on the strange beaching phenomena continues here in Darkshore.  Might you have anything additional to offer us?
4733-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4762-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-progress.text: The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in Darkshore.  The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
4762-progress.title: The Cliffspring River

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4812-progress.name: Unknown
4812-progress.text: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore.  You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
4812-progress.title: As Water Cascades

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

78124-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78124-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78124-progress.title: Nar'thalas Almanac

79093-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79093-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79093-progress.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

86614-progress.name: Khara Deepwater
86614-progress.text: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?
86614-progress.title: Silver of the Waves

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

944-progress.name: Unknown
944-progress.text:
The Master's Glaive, $N.

Go there, then speak with me again.
944-progress.title: The Master's Glaive

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

95065-progress.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-progress.text: Did you get the fishing supplies?
95065-progress.title: Fishin' Time

951-progress.name: Onu
951-progress.text: $N.  Has your rooting through the Ruins of Mathystra been fruitful?
951-progress.title: Mathystra Relics

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

967-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-progress.text: You have some business with me, $c?
967-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

970-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-progress.text: Have you acquired that soul gem?
970-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

97220-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97220-progress.text: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220-progress.title: Philmor's Favor

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98042-accept.name: Aldonalbur
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-progress.text: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042-progress.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

983-progress.name: Unknown
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

986-progress.name: Terenthis
986-progress.text: I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.
986-progress.title: A Lost Master

98896-complete.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98896-complete.text:
Excellent work, $c! With each blow struck against the Darkspear Raiders, we move one step closer to total victory. 

For the Alliance!
98896-complete.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98896-progress.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98896-progress.text: The fight in the Darkspear Islands continues, $N. Rally your forces and crush the Darkspear Raiders!
98896-progress.title: Darkspear Islands Clash
